$comment: User-editable custom Sci-Fi voyages merged automatically by `npm run voyages` / `npm run update-db`. Waypoints can specify either `systemId` (e.g. 'hip-8102') or `system` (star name such as 'Tau Ceti' or 'Epsilon Eridani'). Entries with `_example: true` are ignored.

subtitle.en: Replace _example with false (or remove it) to include this scenario in the Voyages Library.
subtitle.cs: Odstraňte pole _example (nebo jej nastavte na false), chcete-li scénář zařadit do knihovny výprav.

physicsNote.en: 1g brachistochrone flip profile between Sol and Tau Ceti.
physicsNote.cs: 1g brachistochrona s otočkou v polovině mezi Sluncem a Tau Ceti.
